scope: Function-identity research only; no bulk promotion or gameplay inference

method.candidate_generation: Same-module normalized current candidates; instruction count from max(2, retail_count//4) through retail_count*4; at least one shared comparable feature; no class prefilter; no fixed Top-K truncation before scoring
method.tie_handling: Absolute score difference <0.005 groups near-equal candidates; each member receives rank interval [first,last], and evaluation uses the last rank; never address-order tie-break
method.graph_scoring: No graph feature is added by the committed validator; body+callgraph equals body
method.context_scope: Committed pair_context is keyed to the four known retail Flagship toolbar getter RVAs, known Flagship factory RVA 0x83BF0, and known Trim toolbar RVA 0x61240; unseen functions receive no contextual bonus under unchanged scoring

pilot_input_boundary: The committed v3 validator enforces nine controls and fifteen negatives and cannot run unseen functions directly. A separate input adapter may extract selected saved retail Function boundaries with the unchanged extractor and replay unchanged v2/v3 scoring, but must not add contextual rules or alter weights. Such a replay is the frozen-v3 transfer test, not a generic v3 matcher.
